title: Notice Is Not Accessible Participation
summary: A dependency map separating message publication from discoverability, comprehension, access, support, safe participation, standing review, and receipt.
map_question: What must happen before a public notice can support a claim that affected people had a usable opportunity to participate?
interpretation_boundary: Publication, delivery, page views, attendance, and comment counts do not establish discoverability, accessibility, understanding, standing coverage, safe participation, consent, legitimacy, or authorization.

nodes.label: Real public decision question
nodes.note: No Phase 77 decision question is open.

nodes.label: Affected-public and rights-holder standing
nodes.note: The intended audience must be identified and reviewable.

nodes.label: Versioned notice plan
nodes.note: Content, timing, channels, languages, and reach are explicit.

nodes.label: Usable accessibility and support
nodes.note: Format, disability access, interpretation, location, time, technology, safety, and support are tested.

nodes.label: Meaningful opportunity to participate
nodes.note: People can submit, question, deliberate, dissent, and seek correction.

nodes.label: Notice and access receipt
nodes.note: No completed notice or access receipt exists.

links.note: Standing cannot open without a real question.
Notice design follows the affected-public inventory.
Delivery is insufficient when the channel is unusable.
Completion needs independent review and a receipt.

what_this_map_supports: Explicit affected-public, notice, accessibility, support, privacy, and challenge controls.
Review of who could discover, understand, access, and safely use a process.
A bounded receipt without claiming consent or legitimacy.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that notice occurred or that any person participated.
It does not convert access into agreement, consent, legitimacy, or authority.
It does not create a participation score, rank, mandate, or outcome claim.
next_records_needed: An admitted Phase 76 finding and real decision question.
A standing decision plus tested notice, accessibility, and support plans.
Independent review of reach, unresolved barriers, challenges, and receipt.
